props.name: categories
props.description: Labels along the x axis, one per value.

props.name: offset
props.description: `wiggle` minimises how much the streams slope; `silhouette` centres the stack on a flat line.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in viewBox pixels. The width fills the container.

props.name: format
props.description: Format values in the tooltip and the hidden table.

props.name: defaultHidden
props.description: Series ids hidden on first render.

props.name: onHiddenChange
props.description: Called when the legend shows or hides a series, with the ids now hidden.
